regulation_snapshot.us_federal: GENIUS Act signed 2025-07-18 (payment stablecoins, effective ~2027-01-18); CLARITY Act passed House 294-134 (Jul 2025) but failed Senate cloture 49-50 on 2026-09-15 — dead this Congress, 'CLARITY 2.0' draft pending; SEC: liquid staking not a security (staff FAQ), 'Regulation Crypto' proposed 2026-08-18, Innovation Exemption for tokenized stocks (Sep 2026), custody rules proposed 2026-10-06; CFTC no-action relief for passive software providers
regulation_snapshot.tax_general: US: Form 1099-DA (gross proceeds for 2025, cost basis from 2026); IRS DeFi-broker rules nullified by Congress 2025-04-10; OECD CARF data collection from CY2026, automatic exchange from 2027. Not legal advice.

definitions.blue_chip: audited by top firms, 3+ years live, $5B+ TVL (Aave, Lido, Morpho, Sky): direct exploit 0.1-0.5%/yr; incl. indirect losses (bad debt, collateral cascades like KelpDAO->Aave 2026) 0.5-1%/yr
definitions.new_protocol: <$500M TVL, <1 year, unaudited or fork: 3-8%/yr, 10%+ for unaudited forks

base_hack_probability.justification: naive base rate 60-120 DeFi incidents/yr across ~3,563 active protocols ~= 2-3%/yr average, heavily skewed: 1 direct + 2-3 indirect incidents across ~10 blue chips over ~5 years ~= 0.2-0.4%/yr; 207 incidents in H1 2026 (record count) concentrated in small/new protocols; recovery rate only ~10-15% by value (Lazarus cases ~0% return)
